items.note: The eight-row schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of scratch, the coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, and the three stages giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restoration all follow the proof at 741-765. The neighbour relations and the copy/side-injection maps are never defined, so the cancellation ('cancelled by the side wires except on the diagonal') cannot be checked and is loose: in the bit case intersections 0 and 2 are already zero. N and the wire counts are also absent.

It states the frames common to a gate, commutation with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the fact that endpoint frames determine each route, matching 804-825. The edge operator D_vD_u^{-1} and the signed route form eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} are not given explicitly.

S1.3.5 correctly gives the nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m=10^6, nested edges, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h. Missing are L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the triple indicator vectors with orthogonality for neighbours, and the ratios L/N=100/539, 101/539.

The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m and its source-matrix justification (P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})) match 1138-1171. The derivation omits the key fact that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the N rank-one source edges (2P_{U_a}) at 1158-1166, which are what turn the label budget into s_b.

It follows the paper's route: weight additivity modulo four over orthonormal residual bases, one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per basis vector, Z corrections on the 27 support coordinates, undoing the signed exchange to get C^{⊗m} on every role. The statement gives only s_c<W_c m, not s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and never defines the frame C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{⊗m}.

S1.3b correctly says both relative deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, so s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, and S2 gives s_c/W_c<m^σ. The exact η values and the needed fact log m<20 (1332-1337) are absent, and L<N/2 appears only as N-2L_b>0.

The digit moves, the splits and merges, the cyclic row split and the controlled update/scaling at O(V) all match. S1.2 drops the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time from the controls, as well as the prime/unit conditions on q.

It has the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, the triangular factors applied as controlled shifts, and each one of Π realised by D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j with one interchange, exactly as at 1425-1446. The choice of prime q avoiding denominators is not mentioned (minor).

It has the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, the network with shear frames giving H<-H+D using exactly s recursive calls, completion by two linear shears, and F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving F_k=O(e^τ), all matching 1491-1557. The fixed-tape depth-first schedule that justifies the O(V) per-node term (1559-1615) is missing, and so is the explicit three-shear formula.

S1 states the O(Vu^τ) bound, and S1.6 sketches the paper's route: high digits of both chunks as a row field, row padding, base-m pieces, and binary padding to radix q. Missing are the choice of ρ that makes q^{2ρ}≥W^k and the geometric summation Σa_j m^{jτ}=O(e^τ).

It correctly gives s_c child calls on the f=e/m axes of one slot yielding C^{⊗e}, one forward call per inverse child, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. The conjugation by the binary change of basis P_M that moves residual directions to coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate) and the inverse identity are only alluded to ('packed binary basis changes').

The XOR of selected bits, restoration of the third chunk, eight packed cyclic shifts with guard values and repair of the exceptional set match the proof. The cost is given as O(V(L^τ+1)) unconditionally, which the lemma only gives in the parameter family. δ_bad and the selected positions j_i=ρ+iK are omitted.

The recurrence F(e)≤(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1), with children of volume V/W, unrolling to O(d^{λ'}) is right. The leaf rule F(e)=O(e) for e<d^β, the condition on λ', and the q_0-chunk row index are missing.

Its statement (H_0^{⊗D} on one selected bit per chunk, one truncation, O(Vd^{λ'}), error <√2 2^{-p}) and the route through C^{⊗e}, the complex network, packed basis changes and exact dyadic arithmetic match. The guard-width bound is only asserted (depth ≤C_0d^{C_1}); the depth recurrence A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E is missing, and K=⌊d^c⌋ is not stated.

It gives ω_t=y^{2r/t}, decimation in frequency computing B_tF_t^- in bit-reversed order with the reverse F_t^+B_t^{-1}, and the layout L with counterparts LBF^-, F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, error √2ℓ2^{-p} and the stated cost. The character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I is not stated.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, centered residues and the O(rp log(rp)) cost for Q_p(fg/r) match.

Two forward transforms kept in LB order, pointwise products commuting with the record permutation, the opposite transform and scaling by M follow 3425-3442. The derivation of the error bound √2M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p} is not shown.

P_sF_s=2^{2α^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions, error <p^2, time O(tp^{3/2+δ}α), the tensor identity and the exposure cost all match. Missing are the hypothesis θ=t/s-1>p/α^4, the definitions of P_s,P_t, and γ=2dα^2.
The chirp a_j, QF_t u=ā·(a*(ā·u))/T, and the cancellation (RF^+)[(RFu)(RFv)]=(u*v)/S^2 match eq:permuted-chirp and eq:source-permutation-cancel.
The fixed rationals τ, ε, c, λ', δ, κ are given correctly. The size parameters (b, p=6b, d, K, T, t_i, r), α, η and the choice and existence of the distinct primes s_i are absent.
The isomorphism x->∏x_i^{μ_i} preserving cyclic convolution, its triangular implementation and the cost are right. μ_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the triangular digit formula are not given.
x_d->ζy with ζ=e^{πi/r} turning cyclic into negacyclic convolution, with M_C=(f*g)/T, matches.

The source transform 2^γB_0QF_tA=RF_s and the pipeline (digits, Φ, two source transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scalings by S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, carries) follow the paper's six steps. The digit scaling 2^{-b-2} and the conjugation definition of the opposite procedure are not spelled out (minor).
The final error <448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding to exact coefficients and carry propagation match eq:final-error. The intermediate error chain (E_s, E_w) and γ≤b/4 are not given.

The parameter values, the claim that every row divided by Tp is at most p^{1-2κ} (min g_i=2κ), and the final O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}) are right. Tp=Θ(n), the margin list, and the absorption of log factors by p^κ are not stated.
S0 only relies on 'nlogn-conjecture' and motivates via the n log n scan cost. The liminf negation argument is absent.

errors.says: the central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 (bit) or (|S∩T|-1)/2 (complex) is cancelled by the side wires except on the diagonal
errors.paper: In the bit case the side contribution cancels only the intersection-one cases; intersections zero and two already have coefficient zero. In the complex case the side cancels intersections zero and two, and intersection one contributes zero.

errors.says: its rational projection matrices satisfy M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m
errors.paper: The source matrix at X_a is the negative projection -P_{U_a}, not a projection; this sign is essential to the endpoint identity and accounts for the N rank-one source edges.

errors.says: the packed selected-bit XOR costs O(V(L^τ+1))
errors.paper: The lemma's general cost is O(V(L^τ+1)+MA^3+δ_bad MA(R+A)); it reduces to O(V(L^τ+1)) only in the stated parameter family (A=O(p), R super-polynomial, K/log p→∞).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: the scalar exchange network, frames, labels, the projection interface with s_b<W_b m, the matrix-shear cost, the power-width recurrence and the parallel complex/butterfly branch, then the convolution reductions and the cost table. It thins at the conversion of labels into ranks: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N rank-one source edges, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and L/N=100/539 are all missing, so the strict saving N-2L>0 is asserted rather than reconstructed. The fixed-tape O(V) schedule behind the recurrence, and the error/guard-width chains, are also only asserted.

steps.note: It gives h=100 (subsets of [100]), m=10^6, the banks X_a,Y_a, and the fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every auxiliary wire. N=C(h,3)^3 is never stated, and indexing by triples is only implicit.
It has frames common to a gate commuting with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and only endpoint frames mattering. The edge change of frame is implicit.
It has nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each losing h.
S1.3.6 only says 'using the projections P_U as matrices' the ranks sum to s_b. Neither rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U nor the N rank-one source edges are stated.
The final s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is given, but not the budget Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L or L=Ich from which it comes.
The deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m are asserted, but the ratios L/N=100/539 (101/539) below 1/2 that make it true are absent.
It gives the identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m with the X_a computation, and the network performing H<-H+D on every row.
It has the factorization E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and exactly s recursive calls per node.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the relative deficit >20·2^{-50} giving s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ). The auxiliary fact log m<20 is not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the outer parts of the chain: the fixed exchange network, frames, labels, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The arithmetic heart of the saving is only asserted. Rank equals dimension change, the N rank-one source edges, the budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and L/N=100/539<1/2 are missing, so s<Wm is stated without the reason it holds.
